text: Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a type of recurrent neural network used for processing time-series data. They consist of a large, sparsely connected hidden layer (reservoir) with few output connections. Training in ESNs typically focuses on the reservoir's weights, which are usually set randomly, while the output weights are trained using a simple linear regression on the reservoir's activations. Reservoirs are trained to capture the temporal dynamics of the input data effectively.
